category_edits.rationale: Increase exponential pooling decay from 0.8 to 0.9 to retain a longer interest horizon. Preserve normalized, nonpadding causal prefix pooling during training and inference. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so it uses the same readout without additional edits.

            denominator = 0.9 * denominator + valid
